The '''Kaminoan flight pod''' was an [[escape pod]] of [[Kaminoan]] design. [[General]] [[Grievous]] commandeered one so he and [[Asajj Ventress]] could flee the [[Battle of Kamino]].<ref name="ARC Troopers" /> It was also used by [[Advanced Recon Commando|ARC trooper]] [[Fives]] and the [[medical droid]] [[AZI-345211896246498721347|AZI-3]] as a diversion to the [[Kamino]] [[Republic Military|garrison]] as they returned to [[Tipoca City]] to investigate the use of [[Behavioral modification biochip|inhibitor chips]] that influenced [[Clone trooper|clone]] behavior.<ref name="Fugitive">{{TCW|Fugitive}}</ref>

There were old flight pods on the abandoned Kaminoan facility of [[Bora Vio]]. The rogue [[Cloning|clone]] [[Omega]] used a flight pod to flee from [[bounty hunter]]s [[Cad Bane]] and [[Fennec Shand]] before she was rescued by [[Clone Force 99]].<ref name="Bounty Lost">{{TBB|Bounty Lost}}</ref>
